title: Insulation & Drywall

stage.name: Walls
stage.description: Walls are insulated and closed in. The house starts to feel like rooms.

options: Slows heat moving in and out, so the house stays comfortable
questions.why: Insulation keeps warmth in during winter and out during summer.

questions.prompt: Drywall goes up after the pipes and wires have been inspected.
questions.why: Closing the walls too early would hide anything that needs fixing.

questions.prompt: What is a vapor barrier for?
options: Keeping moisture out of walls, where it could cause mold
questions.why: Moisture trapped inside a wall can rot wood and grow mold, unseen.

questions.prompt: Insulation keeps comfort in. In a relationship, healthy boundaries…
options: Protect what's private and help both people feel safe
Keep the other person out of your life
Are rules one person sets for the other
questions.why: Boundaries agreed together protect the relationship, not just one person.

talk: What's something you'd like to keep just between the two of you?
